title: Synthetic sentiment gold set and accuracy eval
description: Author a small gold set of labeled synthetic messages modeled on real coding-chat patterns (no real text), covering positive, neutral, negative, and coding-domain-positive/negative usages. Add an eval that reports classification accuracy per backend. Done when: the gold set is committed, the eval runs in tests, and accuracy is recorded on BlackbookM1.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Synthetic gold set at annotations/KDATAP-fe4c1d/sentiment-gold.yaml: 36 labeled messages modeled on coding-chat patterns (10 positive, 2 positive-with-technical-words, 14 neutral commands/technical statements, 8 negative emotional, 2 negative-with-technical-words, 2 excluded/stripped), all synthetic, none real. Eval spec tests/unit/sentiment/sentiment-gold-eval.spec.ts gates accuracy at 0.85 and checks the excluded-null path. VADER result: 34/34 non-excluded correct (accuracy 1.000), 2/2 excluded routed to null.
